review.brief: Review RM49-account-add-analysis-start-date (tier 1 of roadmap RM49). Validate: (1) module-boundary compliance — internal/account imports no tesla/gateway, pgtype absent from public signatures, internal/clock adds no cycle; (2) every doc-pack convention, especially ai/go-conventions.md persistence and time-zone rules; (3) spec/tasks coverage — every tasks.md checkbox reflects real work; (4) the DB objects match the user-confirmed design (decision G1) exactly — any mismatch is a blocker finding; (5) the integration test asserts the expectations design.md's Test Contract authored up front, not whatever the implementation happens to do (the leader changed three comparisons in service_integration_test.go — check the expected value is derived independently of internal/clock); (6) Performance-Profile compliance (read-heavy; D3's no-new-index claim); (7) docs-track-change — AGENTS.md, kkpa/context/, deployment.md 8.11a; the archive must be untouched; (8) anti-gaming — no weakened criteria, no self-approved statuses. Judge test quality by READING the tests; never run the suite.
